Subject: Renewal runway and exposure — GreenLines subscription

Hi Mina,

We're starting a renewals review for the data platform team and I want to get ahead of any exposure for next quarter. Attached is our current license/seat summary (GreenLines_Q4_license_summary.xlsx). Headcount changes and an internal budget freeze make the renewal a bit tighter this cycle.

Could you share your forecast / commit estimate for GL-4721 and any short-term options (monthly smoothing, deferral, or a one-quarter hold) we could consider? Procurement will be involved — copying them on follow-ups.

- Current committed ARR figure you have for our account
- Any discounts or billing timing accommodations available for a 12-month renewal vs. 6-month

Appreciate a quick reply — we're aiming to lock decisions by the end of October.

Thanks,
Erin Lee
Head of Data Products
GreenLines

Short answers up front:
- Committed ARR on file (current term): $235,000 annualized (license + usage buffer).
- Short-term options: we can do a one-off billing deferral for 30 days, or split into two equal invoices over the contract year (requires finance sign-off).
- Purchase order cutoff for existing pricing: 2026-10-31 EOD (if PO is received we can honor current tier pricing).

I'm adding Marissa (renewals) and Ben (sales ops) to confirm staging and any incentives for a 12-month vs 6-month lock. Would you be available for a 30-min sync tomorrow afternoon to walk the numbers and surface any procurement constraints?

Mina / team — quick internal note (circling back on GL-4721).

Context: Erin flagged budget pressure and potential headcount reductions. Current committed ARR $235k. Our playbook: 1) lock 12-month at targeted discount; 2) offer short-term smoothing only if PO commitment in hand; 3) protect revenue by adding modest usage buffer so we avoid day-one overages.

Recommendation / asks:
- Stage: move to "Commit Review" and indicate as high exposure (risk score: 7/10) given procurement involvement and timeline.
- Forecast adj: reduce expected close certainty to 60% from 75% until PO received.
- Pricing options: approve up to a 10% contra on list for 12-month if we get locked by 10/31. Ben / Logan to confirm finance thresholds.

Ben — can you surface previous discount history for GL-4721 and confirm whether a 10% concession needs manager approval or can be done at renewals desk?
Logan — please update HubSpot deal with revised probability and attach the license summary + forecast_notes.pdf. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/GL-4721

Thanks — Marissa
